names: The schedule and the maps name rooms differently. Continental 1–3, 7 and 7–9 are Parlors on the map; Continental 4, 5, 6 and 4–6 are the Ballroom.

routes.title: Lobby to the expo
routes.text: From the Hotel Lobby, pass Registration and Swag Pickup, then go through the Expo Entrance into Golden Gate.

routes.title: Up to Level 2
routes.text: The escalators are on the far left of the expo, across the floor from the lobby. From registration, the stairs and six elevators at the top right are closer.

routes.title: Keynote to Expo Sessions
routes.text: Allow extra time. Go up the left corridor and along the top: the marked door to Parlor 1–3 is at the right end of its top wall. An arrow on its right side may be a second door, or may point to the restrooms.

routes.title: Keynote to Parlors 7–9
routes.text: Go down the left corridor and around the corner. The doors face the bottom corridor.

routes.title: Speaker Lounge
routes.text: Its door is on the right-hand corridor. A line across the bottom corridor looks like a partition, so you may need to cross along the top. Check on site.

plans.label: Level 1
plans.alt: Level 1 floor plan with the sponsor booth key. The Hotel Lobby, Registration and Swag Pickup are on the right, the Expo Entrance leads left into the booths at Golden Gate, the buffet and Build Lab are at the back, and escalators to Level 2 run along the far left. Stairs and six elevators are at the top right.
notes: Lobby side (right): Hotel Lobby, Registration, Swag Pickup and AGI Pill Prescription Refill.
Expo floor (center): the booths, with Google DeepMind at top center. The key below the plan matches booth numbers to sponsors.
Back of the expo (top): buffet, Build Lab at top left, and a seated networking area.
A second seated networking area is at bottom center.
Restrooms, stairs and six elevators are at the top right.

plans.label: Level 2 · Nov 10 workshops
plans.alt: Level 2 floor plan for the November 10 workshop day. From top to bottom along the left corridor: Workshop 1 in Continental Parlor 1–3, Workshop 2 in Ballroom 4, breakfast and lunch in Ballroom 5, Workshop 3 in Ballroom 6, and Workshop 4 in Parlor 7–9. The Speaker Lounge is on the far right.
notes: Top to bottom along the left corridor: Workshop 1 (Parlor 1–3), Workshop 2 (Ballroom 4), breakfast and lunch (Ballroom 5), Workshop 3 (Ballroom 6), Workshop 4 (Parlor 7–9).
Workshop 1 also carries “Fighting Slop in Software Factories.”
Left corridor: Podcast, Livestream Lounge, two charging stations, Red Carpet, two OpenAI spots and the escalators.
The Claude spot is on the wall above Parlor 1–3. The Speaker Lounge is on the far right.

plans.label: Level 2 · Nov 11–12 sessions
plans.alt: Level 2 floor plan for the November 11 and 12 session days. Keynote Sessions fill Continental Ballroom 4–6 in the center with three doors off the left corridor. Expo Sessions are in Parlor 1–3 at the top. Parlor 7 is the Token Billionaires Lounge by Devin, Parlor 8 is the Google DeepMind private meeting room and Parlor 9 is staff only. The Speaker Lounge is on the far right.
notes: Center: Keynote Sessions in Ballroom 4–6, with three doors off the left corridor.
Top: Expo Sessions in Parlor 1–3, with the Claude spot on the wall above it.
Bottom: Parlor 7 (Token Billionaires Lounge by Devin), Parlor 8 (Google DeepMind private meeting room), Parlor 9 (staff only).
Left corridor: Podcast, Livestream Lounge, two charging stations, Red Carpet, two OpenAI spots and the escalators.
The Speaker Lounge is on the far right. Restrooms and six elevators are at the top right.
